# Prime Roofing Florida

> Prime Roofing Florida is an Owens Corning Platinum Preferred Contractor serving Jacksonville, St. Johns County, and Northeast Florida with residential roofing services including shingle and metal roof installations, replacements, and storm damage repair.

The company specializes in coastal roofing solutions for the Jacksonville Beaches area, offering Owens Corning Duration architectural shingles, 1" Ribbon Bead metal roofing, and comprehensive storm damage repair with insurance claim assistance. They serve communities including Ponte Vedra Beach, Atlantic Beach, Sawgrass, and Saint Johns.

- Owens Corning Platinum Preferred Contractor
